name: TeamStarWolf - Supply Chain & Trusted-Relationship Compromise
description: Curated practitioner view of Supply Chain & Trusted-Relationship Compromise behaviors, not an official MITRE mapping. Intrusion through third parties, software/hardware supply chains, trusted relationships, and shared tooling rather than direct exploitation of the target. Cross-tactic selection of Enterprise ATT&CK techniques; scores indicate curated membership tier (core vs supporting), not incident frequency. Every technique ID and tactic is validated against the workbench's bundled ATT&CK v16 data.
